simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to הִלֵּל (H1985) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: הִלֵּל (Hillêl) means Hillel , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Judg 12 13.

definitions.full: H1985. Hillel הִלֵּל proper name, masculine ( he hath praised ; compare Late Hebrew proper name הִלֵּל , Hillel ) father of a judge of Israel Judg 12:13 , 15 , called הַמִּרְעָתוֺנִי see מִּרְעָתוֺן .
